content: {"doneWhen":"Player is at the ladder tile (11,1) in the Mine","modes":[{"name":"navigate","when":"always","actions":[{"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"reach-ladder"}}]},{"name":"fight","when":"a monster is adjacent and facing it","actions":[{"press":["ControllerX"],"ms":100}]}],"skills":[{"name":"reach-ladder","skill":"async (b) => { const path = [[2,8],[3,8],[4,8],[5,8],[6,8],[7,8],[8,8],[9,8],[10,8],[11,8],[11,7],[11,6],[11,5],[11,4],[11,3],[11,2],[11,1]]; for (const [x,y] of path) { const r = await b.walkTo(x,y,'stand'); if (!r.ok) { b.log('walk fail '+x+','+y+' '+r.reason); } } return {ok:true}; }","check":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); return {ok: p.x===11 && p.y===1, detail: 'at '+p.x+','+p.y}; }"}]}
